stemMd: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: "The workshop attracted ___ participants this winter than last winter."
explanationMd: Participants are countable, and than introduces a comparison. The comparative determiner "fewer" fits both the noun and the structure.

distractorRationale.a: This superlative does not compare the two stated seasons.
distractorRationale.c: Participants are countable individuals, so the standard comparison is fewer.
distractorRationale.b: This superlative does not match the than comparison.
